evidence.detail: titlecase.titlecase(name) is called before any ¿ handling
titlecase does not capitalize after ¿, leaving the first word lowercase; also '¿red deck wins?' → '¿red Deck Wins?' with first word still not capitalized

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/deck_name.py, add a step before the first titlecase call (around line 89) to strip leading ¿ characters, e.g. name = name.lstrip('¿'). Add a corresponding test case in decksite/deck_name_test.py.
triage.notes: The inverted question mark ¿ is only used in Spanish and is unusual in Magic deck names; stripping it is safe. The title body references deck #206133 as a concrete example of a deck that would be fixed.
